independence_requirements: Rebuild M1 exact contemporaneous MID bars directly from canonical PACKED17 ticks using an independently written streaming implementation.
Rebuild executable-minute summaries directly from canonical ticks; do not depend on the primary engine minute-cache implementation for the oracle result.
Compute ATR14 using an independently written rolling implementation.
Compute Stage1 signal predicates using independently written explicit causal loops.
Execute BUY Ask-in/Bid-out and SELL Bid-in/Ask-out with Ask>Bid fills only, SL-first ambiguity, same-day deadline, 20-bar maximum hold, ATR multiplier 3 and RR 1.5.
Implement strict one-position selection independently with entry_ts > previous_exit_ts.
allowed_computation: M1_MID signal masks, per-bar execution outcome arrays, and ordered selected-trade ledger hashes may be computed solely for implementation parity. Aggregate strategy PnL/PF/expectancy/winner ranking must not be inspected or used during this gate.
required_checks: Canonical NQX DEV SHA-256 exact before execution.
Both source SHA-256 identities exact before execution.
M1_MID bars = 673097 and exact bar arrays primary vs independent.
M1_MID unique masks = 324 and exact combined signal-mask SHA keyset primary vs independent.
Per-bar BUY outcome arrays entry_ts, exit_ts and R bytes exact primary vs independent.
Per-bar SELL outcome arrays entry_ts, exit_ts and R bytes exact primary vs independent.
For all 324 unique masks × BUY/SELL = 648 ledgers, ordered selected-trade ledger SHA-256 exact with zero mismatches.
No aggregate profitability fields in the parity receipt.
pass_condition: All required checks exact; 648/648 ordered ledger hashes match with zero mismatches. Then the implementation migration is validated and M1_MID economic output may be promoted under the durable primary implementation without changing scientific rules.
fail_condition: Any source, bar, signal, outcome-byte, selection, or ledger-hash mismatch fails closed. No tuning from M1_MID results is allowed.
